caseStudies.heading: How I think
caseStudies.subheading: Three decisions, and the reasoning behind each one.

traffic-optimization.title: Optimization under high traffic
traffic-optimization.context: A media platform's article pages went from a few hundred to tens of thousands of concurrent readers within minutes of a story going viral — and every one of them was hitting the same API endpoint at once.
traffic-optimization.proseIntro: When traffic spikes, the worst decision is letting every user fire their own call to the backend. Here's how I design the caching layer so it can absorb the spike without falling over.
traffic-optimization.decision: Stale-while-revalidate caching for API calls, combined with deduplication of concurrent requests, so a traffic spike produces one backend call instead of thousands of identical ones.

devops-pipeline.title: Multi-repo / DevOps
devops-pipeline.context: A small engineering team was shipping to both a QA and a production environment, with deploys handled by hand — meaning the only thing standing between a broken branch and production was whoever remembered to run the checks that day.
devops-pipeline.proseIntro: This isn't feature code — it's process design. The job here wasn't writing a clever function, it was making sure the whole team could ship without anyone having to remember to be careful.
devops-pipeline.decision: A CI/CD pipeline with quality gates (lint, test, build) that every branch must clear, where QA deploys automatically off develop and production only ships from main behind a required-reviewer environment.

ai-agent.title: Local AI agent with Ollama
ai-agent.context: A personal project: a local agent that runs entirely on-device against Ollama, and needs to act on the real world — check the weather, do a conversion, look something up — without ever giving the model direct access to the filesystem, network, or shell.
ai-agent.proseIntro: The model doesn't get to run anything. It gets to ask. This is the pattern that draws that line — and it's also the base for the playground below, simplified to run entirely in your browser.
ai-agent.decision: Tool-calling orchestration: the model is given a fixed catalog of named tools, its response is parsed for a structured tool call, and only the orchestrator — never the model itself — executes it.
